content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Courses teachable

This is a sovereign commerce stack — a complete combination of free and paid tools that give you a fully operational online store. It processes crypto payments automatically, delivers products instantly, and ensures full data ownership. Unlike platforms that restrict access based on geography or policy, this stack runs on infrastructure you control. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files. NOWPayments verifies on-chain crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. No country restrictions. This is infrastructure sovereignty.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The frontend is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages — both free and globally distributed. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring fast, serverless execution. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, depending on your stack choice. Product files are delivered from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, firing a webhook the moment payment confirms on-chain. This webhook triggers product delivery and order storage. The stack is modular. Each component is replaceable. You own the code. You own the data. You own the deployment. This architecture is designed to operate independently of any single platform or payment processor.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines are examples. These creators sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and digital products. Conventional platforms reject them. This stack provides a permanent structural alternative. It is not a temporary fix. It is base-layer infrastructure. You deploy it once. You own it forever. No platform can shut you down. No payment processor can restrict you. This is commerce sovereignty.
Stripe operates in 46 countries. This stack operates in 195.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, globally distributed hosting. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic without servers. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver product files instantly. NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer account required. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. Each component is chosen for reliability, cost, and sovereignty. The stack is designed to work together seamlessly. You deploy it. You own it. You control it. This is how infrastructure sovereignty is achieved.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing your stack. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys in 48 hours using GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys in 48 hours using Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, with SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured and end-to-end tested. If you prefer to build yourself, purchase The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for complete docs and source code. For full flexibility, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to deploy or download. This is not a tutorial. It is a deployment. You own the stack. You control the commerce. This is sovereignty.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This architecture bypasses platform restrictions entirely. You own the infrastructure. You control the payments. No platform can restrict you. This is how creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, and other restricted regions achieve commerce sovereignty.
PayPal can hold your funds for 180 days. This stack delivers them instantly.
